name: Merton

applications.description:
APPLICATION FOR VARIATION OF CONDITION 2 (APPROVED PLANS), ATTACHED TO LBM PLANNING APPLICATION 25/P1654 RELATING TO THE  REDEVELOPMENT OF THE SITE TO PROVIDE 294 RESIDENTIAL UNITS, WITH ASSOCIATED CAR PARKING, LANDSCAPING AMENITY AREAS, SECURE CYCLE PARKING AND OTHER ASSOCIATED DEVELOPMENT. CHANGES RELATE TO FACILITATING THE PROVISION OF FOUR
ADDITIONAL RESIDENTIAL UNITS. THESE ADDITIONAL UNITS ARE ACHIEVED THROUGH THE
RATIONALISATION OF INTERNAL CYCLE STORAGE AREAS FOLLOWING THE ADOPTION OF THE
GLA’S “SUPPORT FOR HOUSEBUILDING” GUIDANCE, WHICH, AMONGST OTHER MATTERS, INTRODUCED
REDUCED LONG-STAY CYCLE PARKING REQUIREMENTS. IN ADDITION, THE APPLICATION
SEEKS TO REGULARISE A MINOR VARIATION TO THE LOCATION OF THE ONSITE SUB-STATION
IDENTIFIED THROUGH THE DETAILED DESIGN AND CONSTRUCTION DRAWINGS PROCESS.

game.plainAsk: They already have permission. They want to change the deal (294 homes on the books).
game.plainImpact: 294 homes, 20% affordable vs London Plan 35%. This is a major under the usual 35%. West Wimbledon Primary School is within 400 m (not a legal catchment). Kingston Hospital is a hike. Street-crime count in May 2026 is high (207 within 400 m, locations approximate). This borough's 2023–24 affordable pace was 125.
